## How it works

<h2>Developer integration</h2><p>The architectural clinic model opens with red walls, purple slabs, amber doors/windows and green rooms. BCF coloring assigns each group of IFC GlobalIds a color; eight-digit colors use ARGB, including transparency. The page writes one viewpoint with <code>bcf.save()</code> and applies it with <code>viewer.add()</code> and <code>viewer.selectTopic()</code>.</p>
<p>Click a colored component, then click 1 element selected at the top left to open Properties.</p>
<p>Component groups and project identifiers are queried from source bytes through the native <code>viewer.IfcAPI</code>. Colors, camera poses and cutting planes are authored BCF inputs.</p><p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
